_note: Battle points (src/game/BattlePoints.js, docs/GAMEPLAY_PLAN.md §5): earned for what helps the team, spent from the call-in panel. kill: downing an enemy (or killing him outright); finish: killing one who is down; assist: damage on him in the last assistWindow s; vehicle and object: destroying an enemy vehicle or deployable; resupply: per mag a teammate takes from your supply pod or ammo pack; heal: per HP of a teammate's you heal; build: a foxhole, sandbags or a trench link; repair: per HP; capture and neutralize: a point flipping while you stand on it; defend: per second on your team's point while the enemy contests it; deliver: per truckload brought to a depot; spot: an enemy you revealed downed by someone else; teamkill: a teammate downed or killed. deathKeeps: the share of your unspent points you keep when you die. Prices (extra uses, vehicle drops, the hero) are on the call-ins in stratagems.json.
